result.summary: PASS. Baseline in a throwaway worktree (MIX_ENV=test MIX_TEST_PARTITION=46): 'Result: 36 passed' for test/letflow/api/authz_deny_log_test.exs. Coverage: design tests (a)-(j) each have a describe with runnable tests (a: 6, b: 1, c: 5, d: 1 over four request shapes, e: 3, f: 3, g: 3, h: 4, i: 5, j: 2, plus 3 pure route/policy helper tests = 36); no @tag :skip, no TODO. No-leak (d) refutes, against the authz_deny line text only, the raw user id, tenant id, schema name, slug, email, bearer token, unique path/query/body values, master key raw/hex/HEX, sub-key raw/hex, and raw-dump markers, for four request shapes (platform, tenant, two catch-all) - covers user id, tenant id, email, token and raw path. Hash pinned by an independent :crypto.mac recomputation (label, <<1>> expand byte, 'user:'/'tenant:' domain tags, 16-hex truncation) in (a), (e) and (h). Fixtures: setup saves and restores :secrets_master_key, window and clock env and calls AuthzDenyLog.reset in on_exit; async: false; sampling uses injected atomics clock, no sleeps; the CAS race test uses a deterministic arrival barrier with a monotonic deadline. Independent mutants (my own runs, one at a time, in a throwaway worktree, scoped to the new file, reverted with git checkout -- lib after each and 'git status --porcelain lib test' empty each time): M1 raw id instead of HMAC -> 27/36 passed (9 failed: a direct, a router, d, e x2, g CRLF, h table, i master-key, i non-binary id); M2 plain SHA-256 no key -> 30/36 (6 failed); M3 raw request_path instead of route pattern -> 28/36 (8 failed: a router, a cross-tenant, b, c x2, d, route helpers x2); M4 sampling removed -> 33/36 (3 failed: h table, h invalid window, h 50-task race); M5 sampler key ignores caller -> 34/36 (2 failed: h table, h invalid window); M7 domain tag dropped (tenant uses 'user:') -> 31/36 (5 failed); M11 failure path adds Exception.message -> 35/36 (1 failed: i outer failure path); M12 compare_exchange replaced by unconditional put -> 35/36 (1 failed: h 50-task race, deterministically). All 8 mutants killed; each killed by the test the design table names. After the last revert, the unmutated tree re-ran green: authz_deny_log_test.exs plus smtp_test.exs and smtp_smoke_test.exs (the two INV-4 source-scan guards) -> 'Result: 73 passed'. Worktree removed with git worktree remove --force, letflow_test46 dropped (it did not exist as a separate leftover; DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS ran clean). Caveats: step-04-test-designer.json was not present on the branch or in the main worktree when I ran, so I could not compare TEST-DESIGNER's reported counts; the 36-test count matched the task statement and all mutant counts above are my own. Test (i)(1) was not mutation-probed by me beyond the M1/M2 failures it shows; M6 (log on allow branch), M8 (response changed), M9, M10 not re-run by me (not required, three-plus mandated). Main worktree: no checkout/stash/lib edit by me; git status --porcelain shows only the untracked letflow-3.code-workspace (the main worktree is now on a sibling session's branch).
